spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mobile-first full screen flex layouts with absolute positioning for fixed navigation.

glass_morphism.classes: bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]

format_badge.classes: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-md bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest uppercase

bottom_nav.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-24 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-3xl border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-around px-6 pb-safe pt-2 z-50

global.background_animation: Use absolute positioned framer-motion divs with massive blur (blur-[120px]) and slow floating animations (translate, rotate) to create dynamic lighting behind the UI. The colors should subtly shift based on the active tab.

library_tab.layout: Grid of glass cards for Songs, Artists, Genres, Playlists. Large blurred search bar at the top.
library_tab.search_input: w-full bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-6 py-4 text-white placeholder-white/40 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF6B6B]

now_playing_tab.layout: Hero layout. Massive square album art (max-h-[50vh]) floating with a glowing drop-shadow matching the dominant album color. Controls below in a sleek glass container.
now_playing_tab.playback_controls: Play button: w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#2D5BFF]/30 flex items-center justify-center. Skip buttons: w-12 h-12 text-white/60 hover:text-white.
now_playing_tab.progress_bar: h-1.5 w-full bg-white/10 rounded-full overflow-hidden. Inner fill: bg-[#2D5BFF]. Thumb: hidden until interaction.

equalizer_tab.layout: Dashboard-style layout. Top: Segmented control (Presets, 10-Band, 31-Band). Middle: Interactive EQ curve graph (SVG/Canvas). Bottom: Row of vertical faders (sliders) taking up the lower half.
equalizer_tab.fader: Vertical slider. Track: w-1.5 bg-white/10 rounded-full. Fill: bg-[#CDFF00]. Thumb: w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-[#CDFF00] shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(205,255,0,0.5)].
equalizer_tab.labels: Frequency labels (e.g., '60', '1k', '16k') below each fader using 'mono_data' typography.

spectrum_tab.layout: Immersive visualization area. Top half: Real-time audio spectrum visualization (canvas-based bars). Bottom half: Audio Processing Controls (Pre-amp, Tone, Stereo Width, Crossfeed).
spectrum_tab.knobs: Rotary dials for processing controls. Round glass containers with an #FF8A00 arc indicating the current value.
spectrum_tab.visualizer: Multiple vertical bars stretching vertically based on frequency amplitude. Colored with a vertical gradient from #FF8A00 to transparent.

settings_tab.layout: List layout. Groups of settings in glass cards.
settings_tab.list_item: flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-b border-white/5 last:border-0
settings_tab.toggle: Custom Switch. Track: bg-white/10, checked: bg-[#E0F2FE]. Thumb: bg-white. (Requires Shadcn Switch customized)

album_covers.description: Abstract artwork with dynamic warm colors
Dynamic abstract artwork featuring vivid red and blue swirls

background_texture.description: Creative abstract art featuring vibrant fluid lines on dark bg (Use as a fixed background with very low opacity ~10% behind the moving gradients)

interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must brighten on hover (text-white/60 -> text-white).
interactions.tab_switching: When switching tabs, the background ambient light blobs should crossfade to the new tab's accent color (e.g., from Blue to Green).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `framer-motion` for page transitions, tab switching, and the floating background blobs.
This is an Expo React Native app conceptually, but implement it as a PWA / Mobile-Web UI using standard HTML/Tailwind.
For the 5 main tabs, build a state manager to handle activeTab, and use AnimatePresence to crossfade between the screen components.
Ensure the bottom navigation stays fixed (`z-50`), over the content, and has `backdrop-blur-3xl` so scrolling content is visible beneath it.
For the Equalizer: Use HTML `<input type='range'>` customized heavily with Tailwind, rotating it `-90deg` to make vertical faders if needed, or build a custom pointer-events tracker.
Use Shadcn UI for dropdowns or modals in Settings, but override their background to match the glassmorphism theme (`bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10`).
Implement format badges (FLAC, 64-bit, DSD) as small monospace pills using the `mono_data` text specs.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards against the dark glass by heavily utilizing `text-white` for primary data and `text-white/60` for secondary.
